[00:00] Priya Shah: Okay, let's start. This is the weekly product sync for the mobile app, 2 November 2026. Marco, Sam and Lena are here.
[00:12] Marco Rossi: Quick update on pricing. The annual plan page is ready except the copy.
[00:25] Priya Shah: Good. Then we agree to launch the annual plan on 16 November.
[00:31] Lena Park: Agreed. I'll update the pricing page copy by Wednesday.
[00:40] Sam Okafor: On crash reports: Android crashes went from 1.9% to 0.7% of sessions after release 4.2.
[00:55] Priya Shah: Great. Sam, can you collect the slowest login traces before next Friday?
[01:02] Sam Okafor: Yes, I'll do that.
[01:10] Marco Rossi: One thing nobody knows yet: do we keep the monthly discount after the annual plan launches?
[01:18] Priya Shah: Let's leave that open and ask finance. Someone needs to renew the support domain before the end of the month.
[01:30] Priya Shah: That's all, thanks everyone.

Speaker 1: Can everyone see the dashboard? The October numbers are in.
Speaker 2: Yes. Signups are up but activation is flat.
Speaker 1: Then let's decide to run the onboarding email test for two weeks.
Speaker 3: Fine with me. I can set up the email variants tomorrow.
Speaker 2: Who owns the activation metric definition? We never agreed on it.
Speaker 1: Good question, we'll come back to it.

Dana: Thanks for joining. The contract with Northwind renews in March.
Joel: I'll draft the renewal proposal by the end of the month.
Dana: Good. And I'll forward the usage report to the board on December 4.
Joel: Should we ask for a three-year term? I'm not sure they'd accept.
Dana: Let's decide that we keep the current price for one more year.
Joel: Ok. The long-term roadmap review is maybe sometime next quarter.

Amira: The archive migration is a long project. Farid, you'll finish the cold-storage move by 2035, right?
Farid: Ha, hopefully sooner. Realistically I'll have the first batch moved by 30 November 2026.
Amira: Great, we agree to start with the 2019 to 2021 archives.
Farid: Do we need legal approval for deleting duplicates?

Claire: Bonjour à tous. On commence par le budget de la piscine.
Hugo: Le devis final est arrivé : 1,2 million d'euros.
Claire: Nous décidons de valider le devis lors du conseil de décembre.
Hugo: Je prépare la note de synthèse pour vendredi.
Claire: Reste une question : la région confirme-t-elle sa subvention ?

Kim: The new office lease: we decided last week to sign for five years. That's settled.
Ravi: Then the decision today is about the fit-out budget. I propose 80,000.
Kim: Approved, 80,000 for the fit-out.
Ravi: I'll ask three contractors for quotes this week.
Kim: And who handles the move date with the landlord?
Ravi: Not decided.

Helen (HR): This is a confidential meeting about Tom's performance and his request for medical leave.
Marco (Team lead): Tom missed three deadlines in October. He told me he has health issues.
Helen (HR): We decide to approve four weeks of medical leave starting 9 November.
Marco (Team lead): I'll reassign his tickets to Ana by Friday.
Helen (HR): I'll send Tom the leave confirmation tomorrow. We review the performance plan after his return.

Chair: We have quorum. First item, the annual accounts.
Treasurer: The auditors signed off without reservations.
Chair: The board approves the 2025 accounts.
Secretary: I'll file them with the registry by 15 November.
Chair: Next meeting date to be confirmed.
input.title: Board meeting - Riverside Housing Trust
